decisions.reason: Premium support is a low-cost add-on that generates recurring revenue from existing hosting customers, though it was only mentioned rather than featured, so a quiet discontinuation is possible.
The version manager is integrated into the hosting platform alongside the security center and restore manager, which makes it cheap to maintain and useful for retaining customers.
The data processing contract tool came out of the 2018 GDPR wave and its novelty has faded, but it remains legally required and low-maintenance, so keeping it is still worthwhile.
Scalable agency hosting was the 2019 home-page product and fits the core hosting business with recurring B2B revenue, making it a strategic offering to retain.
